linkage: Hidden local logger in each DSO; no cross-DSO dependency or new dynamic export. No shared mutable business state.
entry: void r29_observe(const struct r29_record *snapshot); conceptual interface only; preserves errno and never dereferences address-valued fields
field_rules: Only bounded numeric fields; no strings supplied by apps or media URLs.
valid_mask distinguishes unavailable from zero; missing state/window remains unknown.
Copy only values safely read by existing code; no added unsynchronized state reads. If prior/post state is not safely available, mark unknown.

jobject is call-local only and not retained or used as an identity-table key. For producer records use opaque TextureView.mNativeWindow old/new values plus call sequence; do not infer Java identity from a local reference address.
Provider pointer is valid only if the existing dispatch already supplies that actual typed function pointer; named PLT imports remain unknown until exact ELF/GOT evidence.
correlation: CPU keys: wrapper with trusted OH when available; upgrade unknown OH in-place rather than adding another identity.
Consumer keys: trusted state/image/OH or producer old/new OH pair; no pointer dereference by logger.
Epoch only advances for actual observed configuration/producer/attach-detach transition, not every frame/token or repeated same failure.
Fresh identities and transitions have reserved per-key budget; a prior clip cannot spend another key budget. Same-key transitions invisible to hooks remain explicitly outside coverage.
Across DSOs join trusted OH and operation chronology; distinct local counters do not imply the same transaction.
